title: Briefing for 2026-10-16
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-16: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done. U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting. Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge. China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration. UK economy grew 0.1% in August, beating expectations. How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S..
global: Bus hits train stopped on French side of Channel Tunnel, with 19 injured. Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume. At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan. Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills two, minister says. Was Neanderthal life violent? This wound suggests lethal fighting was more common. Seven crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast.
philippines: RESULTS: October 2026 Physicians Licensure Examination. Sandro Marcos joins Lakas party | The wRap. ‘No person is walang kwenta’: Groups, friends defend Josh Aquino amid podcast controversy. Raul Daza, longtime congressman of Northern Samar, dies.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
